arguments.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'

SELECT 'bookings' AS t,json_group_array(json_object('id',booking_id,'request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'ref',client_reference)) AS rows FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'events',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox UNION ALL SELECT 'cancellations',json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_group_array(json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'pending' AS t,json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'status',b.status,'ref',b.client_reference,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'cancel_step',e.step)) AS rows FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',o.booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id)) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancellations',json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'payment_logs',json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'message',message,'status',status)) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 15)

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.client_reference,c.charge_id,c.state,c.idempotency_key,e.kind AS customer_event,e.step AS event_step,(SELECT json_group_array(b2.booking_id) FROM bookings b2 WHERE b2.client_reference=b.client_reference AND b2.status='confirmed') AS confirmed_same_reference FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) WHERE b.status!='confirmed' OR e.event_id IS NOT NULL
